title: Field access
subtitle: Give the crew on this farm a phone-and-PIN sign-in for the Scout app.
noFarmSelected: Choose a farm to see who can be given the app.
loadFailed: Could not load the worker list.
empty: No workers recorded on this farm yet.

pin.heading: PIN for {{name}}
pin.readAloud: Read this out to them now. There is no text message and no email — this is the whole handover.
pin.onceOnly: This is the only time it is shown. If it is lost, issue a new one.

ready.heading: Ready for the app
ready.hint: These people have a phone number and a job title that can hold a sign-in.

blocked.heading: Cannot sign in yet
blocked.hint: A field worker can be put on the board but can never sign in. Promote them to Scout first.

noPhone.heading: No phone number
noPhone.hint: The phone number is the username, so there is no account to create until you have one.

enrolled.heading: Already have the app
enrolled.hint: Forgotten PINs are replaced, not looked up.
enrolled.none: Nobody on this farm has the app yet.
enrolled.noAccount: This worker is linked to a member who did not get their sign-in here.

mismatch.heading: Can be given work here but cannot open it
mismatch.hint: These people are on this farm's roster and hold no access to it. Work assigned to them here will not reach their phone. Add the farm to fix it.
